name: Linkage
desc: A drafting plate of working four-bar mechanisms, each figure in its own ruled cell — cranks turn, rigid coupler triangles tumble, rockers swing on hatched ground pivots, and every coupler point drags a bright pen-head around the closed roulette it is cutting; each section the plate re-drafts one figure and the new curve draws itself in.

energy.doc: crank rate + bar line weight + pen-head glow + plate float

scale.doc: figure size — a true plate zoom; 2.2 gives a few huge figures, 0.55 a dense sheet of small ones

density.doc: how many distinct mechanisms in the pool (3..14) before the grid repeats

trail.doc: length of the bright pen-head trail along each coupler curve

anno.doc: annotation density: cell frames, FIG numbers, link tables, title block

style.doc: aesthetic: toned drafting film / prussian cyanotype / aged engraved plate / additive x-ray ghost / kinematic (bars dissolve to pivots + velocity & acceleration vectors)

seed.doc: link proportions + coupler-point offsets + grid assignment

alpha.doc: ink opacity over the plate ground
